description: This is a C# source file defining the HttpService class, which provides methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), serializing/deserializing JSON data, and handling errors within a Blazor application.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: A service class for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with JSON serialization, deserialization, and error handling, used within a Blazor application.

methods.name: HttpGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URI and deserializes the response into the specified type.

methods.name: HttpDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request for a resource identified by URI and ID, then deserializes the response.

methods.name: HttpPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with data serialized as JSON, deserializes the response, and handles errors by showing toasts.

methods.name: HttpPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with JSON data, then deserializes the response, with error handling.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object to JSON and creates a StringContent for HTTP request payload.

methods.name: FromHttpResponseMessage
methods.description: Deserializes the HTTP response content into the specified type.
